key_insight: VideoGen-Agent turns video generation into an agentic, tool-using process rather than a single-shot model prediction. By learning to augment, generate, and verify with external tools, it better handles prompts that need specialized knowledge, identity consistency, physical plausibility, or ordered events.
problem_solved: Standard video generation models can produce realistic clips, but they often fail on complex prompts that require external knowledge, consistent identities, temporal logic, or strict physical coherence.
method: Train a multimodal agent with multitask agentic reinforcement learning so it can decide when and how to use tools.
Coordinate external augmentation, generation, and verification tools in a closed-loop workflow for more reliable outputs.
Use tool-assisted reasoning to improve prompt adherence for hard video tasks involving identity, order, and consistency.
impact: This matters for practitioners because it moves video generation toward controllable, task-oriented systems that can be more reliable on real-world prompts. It suggests a practical path to improve quality without relying solely on larger generative models.
